description: Destroy one of an organization's own checkers by name. Valet stops sending release files to its URL. Confirm with the user first. A checker that a release policy names is refused: the answer names the policies, so destroy_policy them first, or point them at another checker with set_policy. Destroying a checker that is already gone changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account. Requires the Admin role.

checker.description: The checker's name, such as org:snyk as list_policies reports it, or snyk.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the checker belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: destroy_checker

already_gone.description: True when the thing was already gone before the call, so nothing was destroyed. Absent when this call destroyed it.

kind.description: What the thing was, such as channel, connector, or resource.

name.description: Name of the thing the call destroyed, as the caller gave it.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

title: Destroy an organization checker
